notes.title: 101XP Summer Sale 2024
notes.content:
What could be better than many awesome discounts and a hot announcement of our new upcoming project? We are excited to unveil the launch of our own Summer Sale on Steam! Only until August 2, purchase all 101XP games at the best of prices!

Walk the path from birth until true death in the harsh world of the critically acclaimed narrative-driven RPG—[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272160/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Sir_Brante/]The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante[/url]! Be prepared to make difficult choices and answer for your fateful decisions that lead to irreversible consequences.

Get immersed in the retro-futuristic world of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1596730/Dynopunk/]Dynopunk[/url], where the main character, Chris the T. rex, runs a repair shop and pursues his life’s dream, all set to a nostalgic Lo-Fi soundtrack!

Try on the mayor’s suit in the acute social visual novel [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1146600/For_the_People/]For the People[/url], where you will sort out your citizens' appeals and uncover political conspiracies.

Or maybe you are into thrilling and atmospheric adventures? Then why not go on a journey through the world of nightmares and grim fairy stories in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1307690/The_Darkest_Tales/]The Darkest Tales[/url], or search the ruins of post-apocalyptic Japan as a cyber samurai in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294880/Blind_Fate_Edo_no_Yami/]Blind Fate: Edo no Yami[/url]?

Or perhaps you are looking to set aside all the philosophy and dramatic storytelling to simply enjoy the fast-paced gameplay of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2488510/FatalZone/]FatalZone [/url]and annihilate hordes of abominable undead?

And if you feel like acquiring several games at once—or it just so happens that you already have some of them and are looking to complete your collection—then our lucrative bundle offers will make such a purchase even more cost-effective!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/101xp/sale/101XPpublishersale2024][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38127382/0f2797f02b08c9e70b1232325c353d53bb84ec73.jpg[/img][/url]

There is also another grand development to report—we have literally just announced a new title in the beloved Life and Suffering universe!

The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian is a narrative-driven RPG that takes place on the pages of a book, where you will become not just a hero but the heir to the throne of the Blessed Arknian Empire—the seat of power in the world ruled by real and merciless gods. A new life-long journey awaits, full of difficult moral dilemmas, palace intrigue, the search for answers to the mysteries of creation, and heavy choices with far-reaching consequences not only for yourself but your entire Imperial domain.

Wishlist The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2936290/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Prince_Jerian/

Follow us on social media and be the first to learn all the latest news:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@101XPcomgames]YouTube[/url]

notes.title: The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian — a new narrative RPG from Schisma Games
notes.content:
It is our pleasure to announce a new narrative roleplay adventure from the minds behind [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272160/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Sir_Brante/]The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante[/url]!

The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian is a narrative roleplaying game that casts the player as the heir to the Blessed Arknian Empire, who must carve out a destiny for his nation. The world is grim, and the gods are eager to punish anyone who breaks their commandments. People live preordained lives, their fates sealed the moment they are born. It is up to the player to decide what kind of leader they will be: uphold the established order, or build a new kind of future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2936290/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Prince_Jerian/

You, Prince Jerian of House Tempest, must embark on a lifelong journey. It starts in your childhood, blissfully ignorant of your destiny, and continues into maturity as you take up a role you have been primed for since birth: emperor. As crown prince, you must not only understand your country and its culture, but also make many difficult choices that affect the fragile balance of powers in the Empire, and inside yourself. If you go where political circumstance and family obligations guide you, you risk losing yourself in the chaos. Can you keep yourself whole, or will you shatter?

Check out the trailer, which will give you some first impressions about the upcoming game!

[previewyoutube=LsJb0TVRytc;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition, to celebrate the official announcement of the game, we are releasing a special video address from the development team at Schisma Games, in which they will pull back the veil of mystery shrouding the contents of their upcoming title. Come watch!

[previewyoutube=RdUQLk17Vqo;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is currently in development. Wishlist The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian now and subscribe to our newsletter to never miss an update!

Join our bustling [url=https://discord.gg/YWRm476CVE]Discord community[/url], the best place to make the wait for the new game a bit more enjoyable. Any questions you have, you can ask there. Discuss the game world with like-minded players, share your ideas and suggestions, and be among the first to hear any news about the game!

notes.title: Unlocking Development Secrets!
notes.content:
Today, we are lifting the veil of secrecy over the game’s development process and will share a few words on what is happening behind the key feature of HellFlame — the physics system that controls all the in-game objects.

It all started with us not wanting to just make another regular title. Instead of the conventional approach to game development, we decided to take our project in a rather unusual direction by investing our effort, resources, and time into a new technology that we believe can deepen the game experience and serve as the basis for many fresh and unique gaming moments.

That is what we did — we developed one of the most scalable and accurate physics systems to date and called it MAPSFY, an expansive and accurate physics engine. (Share your thoughts as to what the full acronym might stand for in the comments below! 🙂) MAPSFY is able to calculate and simultaneously display an incredible number of 10,000 3D models within a single scene, all with seamless and smooth processing on virtually any device.

This system forms the basis for our new game, HellFlame — an arena bullet heaven where, thanks to the aforementioned tech, all objects can physically interact with each other, and the enemies literally react to your every move. Imagine that you are locked in a small area with hundreds of demons coming to get you from all sides. You are free to use and combine up to 6 weapons at once, putting together an arsenal that would help you deal with foes in the most effective and spectacular way possible: chop fiends with swords, pierce them with stakes, or watch monsters fall in droves from your blows, collide, try to get up and rush into battle again, or go flying straight down into the abyss. Use elemental features and other objects scattered around the arena to your advantage: set enemies on fire or extinguish them, blast them with lightning or freeze their hides, turning demons into ice chunks that easily break into tiny pieces. Efficiency, spectacle, scale and, of course, the pleasure of battle itself — that is what we aim to achieve!

Specifically for you, we have prepared a short video that shows how the game developed during the past five months. A lot of work has been done, and we are excited to share our progress with you. Keep in mind that HellFlame is still in the early stages of development and will only get better!

[previewyoutube=bqDDJnRSpxE;full][/previewyoutube]

Your support means a lot to us, and we invite you to join us on this experimental and even slightly crazy adventure. It is an amazing opportunity for you to influence the development of a new title from scratch, while for us, it is an invaluable chance to hear your opinion and read your comments about our project. Together, we can make HellFlame the best game it can be!

[url=https://discord.gg/xVG4zWGfs9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712886/605fe3080b269dd0a0c974aa2f4edf35dc1edfa9.jpg[/img][/url]

Join us and stay in touch so that you do not miss out on all the latest news! We will be back with more details on HellFlame and small teasers later.

notes.title: Meet HellFlame - a New Survival Roguelike!
notes.content:
HellFlame is an in-development arena-based auto-shooter and survival roguelike where you can choose an angelic class that suits your playstyle before descending into the very heart of Hell.

Fight off hundreds of thousands of demons and watch them scatter around and fall into the abyss in the game with one of the most extensive physics simulation systems ever! With realistic object and environment behavior, enemies will react to your every action.

Combine up to 6 abilities from dozens of available skills, use destructible structures in the arena to your advantage, and don't forget about handy elemental effects. Increase your stats and become stronger to eventually clear all seven floors of Hell and defeat Satan himself!

We're pleased to present the first gameplay trailer, which will help immerse you in the atmosphere of large-scale and spectacular battles between good and evil!

[previewyoutube=usUyT4QWqeQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Please note: the gameplay shown here was recorded using an early build of the game and represents a work in progress, meaning that the final version will be even better! Very soon, we'll be able to lift the veil of secrecy to share development information and materials, including in-game screenshots and videos. Stay tuned for more!

We’d be very glad if you added the game to your Wishlist. Also, don’t forget to subscribe to our feed, so as not to miss upcoming exciting development news. Your support means a lot to us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44712886/e187dfde67bda82ee5d3133de0a985083203b26e.gif[/img]

Join [url=https://discord.com/invite/xVG4zWGfs9]our Discord server[/url] — the best place to discuss HellFlame. There you can ask any questions, share your feedback and predictions, as well as express your wishes and opinion on how to improve the game. We’re looking forward to hear from you about the future of our title!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479830/The_Braves/
